title: ForbiddenError

reason.description: Present when the scope is held but the call would grant a ceiling above the caller's own: a pairing, or raising another client session.

ceiling.description: With reason ceiling: the caller's own ceiling, the highest it may grant.

description: The client session lacks the scope the method requires, named in data.scope; or, with data.reason ceiling, the call would grant a ceiling above the caller's own, named in data.ceiling.
